scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm knip && pnpm test:coverage
scripts.dev: node dev/env.ts && pnpm --filter directus-extension-geospatial build && docker compose --file dev/compose.yaml up --detach --wait && pnpm --filter directus-extension-geospatial dev
scripts.spike: pnpm --filter directus-extension-geospatial build && pnpm --filter "directus-extension-geospatial-spikes*" build && vitest run --project "spike:*"
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --project unit --coverage && pnpm test:integration && node test/coverage.ts && node test/ratchet.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc && tsc -p packages/contract && tsc -p packages/extension && tsc -p spikes/extension && tsc -p spikes/hook
